svg.title: Editor Animation panel (proposal)
svg.desc: The editor with the Animation panel open in the bottom dock next to Output. The panel is pinned to Level/AnimationPlayer while the Lift node is selected. It has a transport toolbar, an animation menu, a track list grouped by node, a timeline canvas with ruler, keys, playhead, a method key and an audio clip, and a key editor row. The inspector shows key-insert buttons next to Lift's animatable properties, one with its tooltip.
svg.text: File Edit View Project Run Help

g.text: Animation tab in the bottom dock, next to Output; pinned to a player.
Transport: backwards, from start, play, pause, stop; position.
Animation menu (library/name); new, duplicate, rename, delete.
Length, loop mode, snap step, seconds/frames, curve view, zoom.
Track list grouped by node; interpolation, wrap, enable, remove.
Timeline canvas (the shared timeline from the song tab): ruler,
keys, playhead (drag to scrub); past the length is shaded.
Method keys show the call; audio keys show the clip's waveform.
Key editor: the selected key's time, value, easing, interpolation.
Key buttons on animatable inspector rows insert a key at the playhead.

svg.text: Proposal (G1a). The panel is an RmlUi document (animation.rml) around one canvas image of the timeline, like the song tab.
Every button is an icon with a tooltip. Editing in the panel previews the animation on the edited scene.
